Oneliner

World’s smallest two-way communications satellites for IoT.
Description

Test the world’s smallest two-way communications satellites to serve as a cost-effective low-data rate Internet of Things (IoT) network connectivity solution for remote and mobile sensors. Test a new antenna configuration and an even more advanced onboard communications system, developed in-house! Demonstrate the performance of new satellite designs for low-power and lower data rate VHF communications between ground stations and satellites.
